AI · Onboarding & Insights
A native WeChat Mini Program experience plus an instant, no-install H5 menu. Put two QR codes on the table and guests can scan either one.
Hot or iced, sweetness, ice level, noodle base, extra portions, hold-the-prep — prep options render exactly as you configure them, so "no milk, less sweet" comes through just as the guest said it.
The moment an order lands, the cashier master ticket and the kitchen route tickets print together — tea charge and service charge are added automatically per store settings.
Direct cloud-printing integration with a live-scrolling KDS display; tickets route by dish-to-printer binding, so nothing goes to the wrong printer even at peak.
Bind dishes to printers
A single dish can bind to multiple zone or label printers, locking the destination the moment it's ordered; combo sub-items route with their parent dish.
Two columns — In Progress and Ready — scroll in real time and update the instant food is plated; no calling orders, no passing paper.
The label printer stamps bold pickup numbers to stick on containers — matching a pickup is faster than making eye contact.
Reprints, voids, and re-prints are all logged, so kitchen and front of house can reconcile without relying on anyone's memory.
Self-pickup takeaway with no commission: independent pickup pricing, auto number assignment, and scan-to-hand-off.
Independent takeaway pricing
Set a separate pickup price for takeaway; when it exceeds the dine-in price, a strikethrough comparison shows automatically so guests see it instantly.
A pickup number is assigned the moment an order is placed, and an estimated pickup time is written into the order; guests watch "Preparing / Ready for pickup" live.
The in-store TV shows pickup progress plus promo content and the takeaway QR — open it directly in the TV's browser, no login needed.
Preset daily stock auto-replenishes; sold-out items auto-reject orders instead of accepting a half-order; voided orders auto-return stock.
A daily special auto-reverts to the regular price the next day — no one has to remember to "change it back tomorrow."
Today's and this month's GMV, live operating metrics across your stores, and in-progress order volume — all on one page.
Your own Mini Program
A brand can bind its own WeChat Mini Program AppID, so guests are entering your Mini Program.

Upload a menu photo, Excel, or Word file and it's recognized into a structured dish list; HK-style rules generate automatically: drink hot/iced expansion and the no-ice / less-sweet / no-milk prep options.
Feed today's live data plus yesterday and the last 7 days into the model, and get an interpretation right on the POS sales page: which daypart is weak, which dish to push.
Not sure yet that it's practical? Scan a QR and try it yourself

Dimorder is developed and operated by TEAMOTTO (HK) LIMITED. We are an engineering team in Hong Kong who have spent years building restaurant and e-commerce systems — a SaaS commerce platform, mini-program networks, cloud print scheduling — and now every bit of that experience is poured into one ordering system for food service.
One team owns the backend, the mini program, the POS and the admin console
Your problem is never bounced down three hops; it reaches whoever writes the code
Commissions, quotas and hardware prices are all published on the pricing page. Every bill comes with a day-by-day breakdown, and we do not accept "system adjustment fees".
New features come from the kitchen and the floor: oversized pickup numbers, dishes bound to specific printers, a void-ticket recycle bin — all born from real complaints and real shifts.
Hong Kong, Kowloon and the New Territories — on-site installation and training
Beyond Dimorder, we also operate the bupopshop e-commerce SaaS platform, building mini-program online stores for brand clients. We also deliver custom software projects for clients.
